  .pipeline-svg svg { width: 100%; height: auto; }

<div class="pipeline-svg">
```{r diagram, results = "asis"}
# Inline SVG (not <img>) so its labels can be links; blank lines would end pandoc's raw HTML block
if (file.exists(svg_file)) {
  svg <- readLines(svg_file, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  svg <- svg[nzchar(trimws(svg))]
  # Not shown on the site (the file itself is unchanged): the "Граница: ..." banner and the "v2" badges
  # with their legend. Each banner / badge text comes right after its own <rect>.
  drop_text <- grepl(">Граница:<|>v2</text>|>новое в v2<", svg)
  drop_rect <- c(drop_text[-1], FALSE) & grepl("^<rect ", svg) & !grepl('class="', svg)
  svg <- sub(" \\(v2\\)</title>", "</title>", svg)
  cat(svg[!(drop_text | drop_rect)], sep = "\n")
} else {
  cat("<p><i>Diagram file nsf_engines_pipeline_v2.svg not found.</i></p>")
}
```
</div>

<script>
// Box labels that link to the Methodology page (found by their text, so a redrawn diagram keeps the links)
(function () {
  var links = { "Профиль технологии": "methodology.html#technology-profile" };
  var svg = document.querySelector(".pipeline-svg svg");
  if (!svg) return;
  svg.querySelectorAll("text").forEach(function (t) {
    var href = links[t.textContent.trim()];
    if (!href) return;
    var a = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "a");
    a.setAttribute("href", href);
    t.parentNode.insertBefore(a, t);
    a.appendChild(t);
  });
})();
</script>
